design_condition: The volume occupies the plot edge, addresses the street, aligns with the existing gymnasium, and shapes differentiated covered and landscaped outdoor spaces around the building.

positive.statement: The urban-planning setting calmly and precisely clarifies the building’s integration into the city body.

position.target: building integration into the city body
position.rationale: Elongated building mass is visible; urban integration is approximated along its central plot-edge surface.

positive.statement: The offset ground-floor uses articulate different covered outdoor spaces toward the street and courtyard.

position.rationale: Ground-level offset is approximated along the street-facing end and adjacent exterior edge.

positive.statement: Freely divisible spatial layers offer great spatial flexibility for the classrooms.

position.rationale: Classrooms are interior, so the layered upper-middle building volume provides the constrained anchor.

positive.statement: The corner arrangement enables interesting lighting options across the building corners.

position.rationale: A distinct lower corner is clearly located in plan and checked against the adjoining elevations.

positive.statement: The regular facade structure blends the new building with the existing building.

position.rationale: Repeated horizontal facade bands are visible on the long elevation and align with the elongated plan.

positive.statement: The differentiated open spaces are sensitively readable and enhanced in three dimensions.

position.rationale: Open-space differentiation is approximated immediately outside the building’s lower street-side edge.

negative.statement: The entry fails to develop sufficient spatial potential from its urban-development quality.

position.rationale: The statement implies a street-facing entry; its precise opening is not distinguishable in the sample.

negative.statement: The different functions are difficult to integrate into a directed and coherent overall structure.

position.rationale: Functional integration applies broadly across the elongated building volume, without a separately visible interior structure.

negative.statement: The hall-like ground-floor plans and classic three-tier layout do not form a precise whole, while the entrances seem random.

position.rationale: The critique concerns the whole ground-floor organization; entrances are not individually identifiable.

negative.statement: The inner hall on the top floor lacks structure and adequate lighting.

position.target: inner hall on the top floor
position.rationale: The interior hall is absent from exterior points; the top-floor central volume supplies a constrained surface guess.

negative.statement: The proposed materiality appears somewhat harsh in combination with the terrazzo floors.

position.rationale: Material character is not encoded, so the long visible facade provides the nearest constrained anchor.
